## Stretch Question 1

__Which delay is the worst delay? Keep working with the cleaned dataset you created in the previous task. Compare the proportion of flights delayed due to Carrier, to Security, and to Late Aircraft. Show this comparison in a Chart and a Table. Describe your results.__

According to the proportions of the chart, Delays due to late aircraft are consistantly the highest when it comes to how many delays it is responsible for each year.

```{python}
import polars as pl
import requests #new for reading in JSON
import io       #new for reading in JSON
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json"
response = requests.get(url)
df = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))

df_empty_to_null = (df
  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.String) == "" )
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.String))
    .name.keep()
  )

  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.String) == "n/a")
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.String))
    .name.keep()
  )

  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.String) == "1500+")
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.String))
    .name.keep()
  )

  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.Int64) < 0)
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.Int64))
    .name.keep()
  )

  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.Float64) < 0)
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.Float64))
    .name.keep()
  )
)

df_null_to_missing = (df_empty_to_null
  .fill_null(pl.lit("missing"))
  .filter(pl.col("year") != "missing")
)

df_fixed_data = (df_null_to_missing
  # Every column with "minutes_delayed" gets missing data changed to the median of the entire column.
  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier")
    .str.replace_all("missing", 
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().mean()))
  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False))

  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft")
    .str.replace_all("missing", 
    pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().mean()))
  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False))

  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_security")
    .str.replace_all("missing", 
    pl.col("num_of_delays_security").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().mean()))
  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_security").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False))
)

df_sorted_data = (df_fixed_data
  .with_columns(pl.col("year").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False).drop_nulls())
  .group_by("year")
    .agg(
      pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().sum(),
      pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().sum(),
      pl.col("num_of_delays_security").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().sum())
)

df_structure = (df_sorted_data
  .unpivot(index = "year",
  on=["num_of_delays_carrier", "num_of_delays_late_aircraft", "num_of_delays_security"],
  variable_name = "category",
  value_name = "total")
)

df_structure = df_structure.with_columns(
    (
        pl.col("total") /
        pl.col("total").sum().over("year")
    ).alias("proportion")
)

(ggplot(df_structure, aes(x = "year", y = "proportion", fill = "category")) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = "stack",
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(format=".0%") +
  scale_x_continuous(format="d") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Comparing Proportions of Delays") +
  labs(y = "Total",
  x = "Year")
)
```

## Stretch Question 2

__Create another chart that shows the proportion of delays for each reason (Carrier, Security, and Late Aircraft) across all 7 airports. Describe your results.__

Across the 7 airports, late aircraft is still the highest % among the 3 delay reasons with the Chicago O'Hare International Airport having the highest proportion at 67%. The airport with the highest proportion of delays due to carrier is the San Diego International Airport with 45%.

```{python}
import polars as pl
import requests #new for reading in JSON
import io       #new for reading in JSON
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)

url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json"
response = requests.get(url)
df = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))

df_empty_to_null = (df
  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.String) == "" )
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.String))
    .name.keep()
  )

  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.String) == "n/a")
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.String))
    .name.keep()
  )

  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.String) == "1500+")
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.String))
    .name.keep()
  )

  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.Int64) < 0)
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.Int64))
    .name.keep()
  )

  .with_columns(pl.when(pl.col(pl.Float64) < 0)
    .then(None)
    .otherwise(pl.col(pl.Float64))
    .name.keep()
  )
)

df_null_to_missing = (df_empty_to_null
  .fill_null(pl.lit("missing"))
  .filter(pl.col("airport_code") != "missing")
)

df_fixed_data = (df_null_to_missing
  # Every column with "minutes_delayed" gets missing data changed to the median of the entire column.
  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier")
    .str.replace_all("missing", 
    pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().mean()))
  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False))

  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft")
    .str.replace_all("missing", 
    pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().mean()))
  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False))

  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_security")
    .str.replace_all("missing", 
    pl.col("num_of_delays_security").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().mean()))
  .with_columns(pl.col("num_of_delays_security").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False))
)

df_sorted_data = (df_fixed_data
  .group_by("airport_code")
    .agg(
      pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().sum(),
      pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().sum(),
      pl.col("num_of_delays_security").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).drop_nulls().sum())
)

df_structure = (df_sorted_data
  .unpivot(index = "airport_code",
  on=["num_of_delays_carrier", "num_of_delays_late_aircraft", "num_of_delays_security"],
  variable_name = "category",
  value_name = "total")
)

df_structure = df_structure.with_columns(
    (
        pl.col("total") /
        pl.col("total").sum().over("airport_code")
    ).alias("proportion")
)

(ggplot(df_structure, aes(x = "airport_code", y = "proportion", fill = "category")) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    position = "stack",
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(format=".0%") +
  scale_x_continuous(format="d") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Comparing Proportions of Delays") +
  labs(y = "Total",
  x = "Airports")
)
